youtube_title: 'Sent Money By Mistake, Please Return' Call? Check This First #Shorts
youtube_description:
SCAM OF THE WEEK #4. An SMS says Rs 10,000 was credited to your account, then a caller begs: 'Bhai, sent it by mistake, please send it back.' Do you return it or check first?
Answer: check your balance in your BANK APP or passbook, never trust the SMS. The SMS is often fake and no money came in. Even if money really came, don't send it yourself: tell the sender to complain to their bank, which reverses wrong transfers. Never enter your UPI PIN on a collect request or link. Fraud? Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.
Source: police and bank fraud advisories, national cyber helpline 1930.
Education only, not financial advice.

SMS: ₹10,000 credited. Phir call: 'Bhai galti se bhej diye, please wapas kar do' 🙏 Honest bano ya pehle check karo?
Sahi hai B — SMS pe nahi, sirf apne BANK APP / passbook pe bharosa. Aksar SMS fake hota hai, ek rupaya nahi aaya. Sach mein aaye bhi hon, toh khud mat bhejo — unhe bolo apne bank mein complaint karein, bank reverse karega. Collect request ya link pe PIN kabhi nahi. Fraud? 1930.
